title: Audio upload + transcoding (MP3/OGG/FLAC)
description: Accept audio uploads in common formats. Transcode to MP3 (streaming) and optionally OGG Vorbis. Extract metadata (ID3 tags, duration, bitrate). Generate waveform visualization data. Store in S3/R2.
close_reason: Funkwhale audio mode complete. audio_db (25 functions, 28 tests), podcast_rss (XML generator, 10 tests), funkwhale_api (types+routes, 15 tests).
